subject: Brightwell launch flight plan & config review
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@brightwellhealth.com>, contracts@brightwellhealth.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Brightwell launch flight plan & config review

Jamie / team — thanks again for the productive call this week. Per our agreement, we’re lining up the internal handoff to Customer Success so they can spin up staging, validate the integration points, and schedule training. Quick summary and asks to make the first two weeks smooth:

- Go-live target: 2028-04-12 (requested by your ops team).
- Scope: real-time triage routing, 6 models (2 rerankers + 4 gen endpoints), embedding snapshots for search.
- SOW / billing: attached Brightwell_SOW_v2.pdf (accepted terms).
- Security note: Customer requested 5-year log retention for audit; we flagged this with Security (they typically require an exception for long retention).
- Immediate asks for CS to start prep: staging API keys, data schema for patient metadata CSV, timing window for nightly sync (we discussed 02:00–04:00 PT).

Monica / Marissa — please own the activation plan. Recommended first steps: 1) staging provisioning, 2) run the config matrix, 3) integration smoke tests with the sample payloads (attached). I included a mutual action plan (BW_mutual_action_plan.xlsx) with milestones — happy to walk through it in 30m if that helps.

Jamie — can you confirm who on your side will be the technical POC for certs and whether the staging environment allows external IP egress to our telemetry endpoint? Also, procurement said they will raise a formal PO this week.

Next actions: I’ll hand over all technical artifacts to CS during the warm-handoff call. Monica, suggest a kickoff slot next Tue/Wed morning PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0146

Attachments: Brightwell_SOW_v2.pdf, BW_mutual_action_plan.xlsx, config_matrix_brightwell.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie@brightwellhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwell launch flight plan & config review

Thanks Karthik — hi Jamie, excited to partner on this. I’m assigning myself as primary activation owner and looping Marissa for escalation and Tessa for implementation scheduling.

Confirming the baseline plan:
- Kickoff (customer-facing): propose Wed 2028-03-21 at 10:00 PT — 60 minutes (staging access, success criteria, timeline).
- Internal prep: we’ll provision staging and run the config matrix by Fri 2028-03-23.
- Smoke tests: Sat 2028-03-24 (non-prod window requested).

Requests for Brightwell now:
1) Staging API key + hostname (or allowlist IPs)
2) Sample data feed (anonymized) and data schema for patient metadata
3) Certificate contact for TLS pinning

Jamie — if you can confirm the POC and whether the 02:00–04:00 PT nightly sync window works, we’ll lock the schedule. If procurement issues delay the PO, we can still start staging work under the warm-handoff with a clickthrough MSA acceptance note.

I’ll create a tracking sheet and invite folks to the kickoff.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie@brightwellhealth.com>, contracts@brightwellhealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwell launch flight plan & config review

Monica — thanks, that timeline works from my side. Quick clarifications from sales/contracts:
- Procurement contact: contracts@brightwellhealth.com (they’ll issue a PO by Mon 03/19).
- Security / retention: Brightwell explicitly called for 5-year retention. I’ve summarized the ask in the linked Jira (DEAL-412) — this will likely need a compliance exception or an appliance-based export. I recommend we flag Security if we can’t meet this with our standard logs policy.
- Integration note: Brightwell will send SFTP credentials for bulk import and needs an initial one-time SSMS dump for historical embeddings.

Jamie — per your note on the call, who will own the certs and can you share the staging IPs? If you prefer, I can introduce you to our Security PM.

Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 17:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Brightwell activation runbook & risks (internal)

INTERNAL NOTE — do not include external recipients (thread contains customer-facing messages above):

Overview: assigned Monica as activation owner. Triage risks flagged during handoff:
- Long-term log retention (5yr) — open security action (assign: Rishi to evaluate export vs retention).
- Embeddings historical import — schedule DB snapshot and test import process (Tessa to coordinate with devops).
- Weekend smoke tests — coordinate with infra on quota and ephemeral staging sizes.

Immediate owner tasks:
1) Monica: open CS ticket, create internal checklist (staging creds, smoke test personas, training plan).
2) Tessa: coordinate staging provisioning with infra and request elevated quota for 48 hours starting 2028-03-22.
3) Karthik: share updated contract/PO when available and follow up on cert POC.

I’ll run a 30m internal alignment on Mon 2028-03-19 09:00 PT to confirm owners and blockers. Add Rishi_malhotra if security review needed.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jamie Park <jamie@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@brightwellhealth.com
Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwell launch flight plan & config review

Karthik / Monica — thanks for the clear plan. A few items from our side:

- PO: attaching a PO stub (PO_Brightwell_0328.pdf). Final will arrive after our finance review but this should let you start procurement activities.
- POC: certs will be handled by Lina Chen (lina.chen@brightwellhealth.com) — I’ll loop her into the kickoff.
- Training: we’d like two 90-minute sessions: one for ops (day-of go-live) and one for admin users (week after go-live). Can your team support recorded training for our internal LMS?
- Support SLA: we require a 4hr response for P1 incidents during business hours (M–F). Please confirm whether that aligns with Redwood’s enterprise support add-on; if not, we’ll plan a managed support window for the first 30 days post-launch.

Kickoff: Wed 2028-03-21 at 10:00 PT works for us. I’ll add Lina and our integrations engineer to the invite.

Thanks,
Jamie Park
VP Ops | Brightwell Health
jamie@brightwellhealth.com

Attachment: PO_Brightwell_0328.pdf
